description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small research and engineering team at a digital trust and security company. You will investigate methods for detecting synthetic media and digital fraud, then help translate effective research into production software.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Investigate AI methods for synthetic media detection, media forensics, and fraud prevention.

 - Read and reproduce research, then assess which approaches are worth pursuing.

 - Design experiments, establish baselines, and evaluate models on realistic data.

 - Implement research ideas and collaborate with engineering to bring successful approaches into production.

 - Analyze failure cases and improve model reliability, generalization, and computational efficiency.

 - Document methods and findings, contribute to technical writing, and prioritize research around practical needs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience training deep learning models in PyTorch, including taking at least one model from concept to production.

 - An MS or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

 - Strong machine learning foundations and experience building, training, and evaluating models.

 - Computer vision knowledge, including CNNs and vision transformers, and the tradeoffs between them at small parameter counts.

 - Experience in at least one relevant area: synthetic media detection, image or video forensics, audio spoofing detection, generative models, or adversarial robustness.

 - Ability to critically assess research papers, design experiments, communicate findings clearly, and turn research into shipped software.

 - Evidence of research and engineering ability through production systems, publications, open-source work, or substantial applied projects.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is flexible based on experience and candidacy. The package includes a performance bonus and 0.25% to 1% equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, United States.
